en: Moved all eight Resolve / Fusion development records to a dedicated LAB / EXPERIMENTS page, with a compact homepage entry.
Added an authorized-download request flow. Online password verification and encrypted builds remain pending secure service setup.
zh: 將 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄完整移至獨立 LAB / EXPERIMENTS 頁面，首頁保留簡潔入口。
新增授權下載申請流程；線上密碼驗證與加密版本下載待安全服務設定後開放。

en: Moved all eight Resolve / Fusion development records to a dedicated LAB / EXPERIMENTS page, with a compact homepage entry.
Added an authorized-download request flow. Online password verification and encrypted builds remain pending secure service setup.
zh: 將 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄完整移至獨立 LAB / EXPERIMENTS 頁面，首頁保留簡潔入口。
新增授權下載申請流程；線上密碼驗證與加密版本下載待安全服務設定後開放。

en: Synced the FusionDynamics2D LAB record to the latest verified 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint and its test / acceptance status.
zh: 同步 FusionDynamics2D LAB 紀錄至目前可驗證的 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint，並補充測試與驗收狀態。

en: Added LAB / EXPERIMENTS with eight Resolve and Fusion development records while preserving existing site sections.
zh: 新增 LAB / EXPERIMENTS，收錄 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄，並保留既有網站區塊與功能。

en: Changed past SY / CHANGELOG entries to stay collapsed by default and expand only when requested.
zh: 將過往 SY / CHANGELOG 更新日誌改為預設隱藏，需手動展開才顯示歷史版本。

en: Added a browsable SY / CHANGELOG to preserve and review site update history.
zh: 新增可瀏覽的 SY / CHANGELOG，用來保存並回顧網站更新歷史。

en: Adjusted overview media on devices without hover support so project thumbnails display in full color by default.
zh: 調整不支援 Hover 的裝置顯示邏輯，讓作品總覽縮圖在手機等觸控裝置上預設直接顯示彩色。

en: Added Discord to the contact links at the bottom of the homepage.
zh: 在首頁底部聯繫方式新增 Discord 連結。

en: Added a historical baseline to the total visitor display while preserving live visitor growth.
zh: 為總瀏覽人數加入歷史基準值，同時保留後續真實訪客數持續累加。

en: Added the Riot Games × Rosewood Creative VALORANT Esports project to the homepage practice timeline.
zh: 在首頁創作時間線新增 Riot Games × Rosewood Creative 的 VALORANT Esports 官方專案。

en: Added a bilingual latest-update summary to the footer date interaction.
zh: 在頁尾最後更新日期加入雙語的本次更新摘要。

en: Added rolling-digit animation to the total visitor count.
zh: 讓總瀏覽人數套用與更新日期一致的數字翻動效果。

en: Added the footer last-updated date and shared visitor counter.
zh: 在頁尾新增最後更新日期與總瀏覽人數統計。

en: Expanded the Work Archive with APP / UI, 3D, drawing and editing projects.
zh: 擴充 WORK ARCHIVE，新增 APP／UI、3D、繪畫與剪輯作品。
